headline: Red day, but GOOGL bucked it and got a buy signal
summary: A broad pullback led by AMD and NVDA dragged the book down 1.39% today, while GOOGL bucked the trend, rose 2.1%, and fired two buy-the-dip signals.
watch: TSM at $399.95 — buy $150 if it slides to $390.
PANW at $317.03 — sell if it falls to $300.
GOOGL at $326.47 — buy $200 now, signal says add the dip.
Sell TEM at market — trend broke down, cut the small stake.
MU at $900.94, still down big — hold, do nothing for now.
NVDA and AMD both fell hard — hold both, no action needed.
recap: Book fell 1.39% to $9,834 today, no cash sitting idle.
AMD dropped 5.1% and NVDA dropped 5.0% — the day's biggest drags.
GOOGL rose 2.1% and fired two signals telling you to buy the dip.
AVGO was flat-to-up (+0.3%); TSM and MU stayed under pressure.
TEM's uptrend broke today — that small stake is a sell now.
